title: 第3章 对赌拿捏老魔头第4章 三尸丸恐怖速度
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
“小子，可曾见过这个人？”
刀疤大汉掏出一张画像，画像上的人，正是那黑袍道人。
“请问您是？”
苏凡警惕的打量着刀疤大汉。
没确认身份之前，他可不敢承认。
“你只管回答我，见没见过？”
刀疤大汉目中凶光闪烁。
“没有没有……”
苏凡连忙摇头。
“没见过，你问我的身份干什么？”
刀疤大汉一把抓住苏凡的脖子，伸手在苏凡怀里摸索着，眼中突然一亮，取出那个黑色袋子。
“你还敢说没见过？”
刀疤大汉眼中杀机暴涌，大手一用力，苏凡立刻进入窒息状态，嘴角一缕血液淌出。
嗖！
就在这时。
一支血色箭矢，携带着惊人的锋芒，刹那穿透刀疤大汉的心脏。
刀疤大汉无力的松开苏凡，转头看向村口，怨毒道：“许三阴，你居然偷袭，卑鄙……”
话没说完就倒在地上，气绝身亡。
一个裹着血袍，衣帽遮住半张脸，满脸皱纹的老人走过来。
苏凡揉着疼痛的脖子，抬头看向血袍老人。

他就是许三阴？
好邪恶的气息，看上去比大狗，更不像好东西。
血袍老人来到尸体前，捡起地上的黑色袋子，仔细确认。
“上仙，终于把你等来了。”
苏凡抱着许三阴的大腿，哭着大喊。
“傻子吗？”
许三阴一愣，一脚踹开苏凡，问道：“给你储物袋的那个人呢？”
这就是储物袋？
以前曾听爷爷说过，但没见过。
“他死了。”
“临死前，他让我把储物袋转交给你。”
苏凡连忙道。
“死了……”
许三阴目光一颤，问道：“他的尸体在哪？”
“我带您去。”
两人来到后山。
许三阴挖开泥土，看着里面的黑袍道人，眼中充满无尽的怒火。
content_en:
"Boy, have you ever seen this person?"
The scarred man took out a portrait. The person in the portrait was none other than the black-robed Taoist.
"Who are you?"
Su Fan looked at the scarred man warily.
He didn't dare to admit it until his identity was confirmed.
"Just answer me, have you seen it?"
The scarred man's eyes flashed fiercely.
"No, no..."
Su Fan quickly shook his head.
"I haven't seen it before, why are you asking me about my identity?"
The scarred man grabbed Su Fan's neck, reached out and groped in Su Fan's arms, his eyes suddenly lit up, and he took out the black bag.
"How dare you say you haven't seen it before?"
Murderous intent surged in the scarred man's eyes, and with a strong hand, Su Fan immediately entered a state of suffocation, and a wisp of blood flowed out of the corner of his mouth.
Whoosh!
Just then.
A bloody arrow, carrying an astonishing edge, instantly penetrated the scarred man's heart.
The scarred man weakly let go of Su Fan, turned to look at the entrance of the village, and said bitterly: "Xu Sanyin, you actually attacked by surprise, how despicable..."
Before he finished speaking, he fell to the ground and died.
An old man wrapped in a bloody robe, half of his face covered by the coat and hat, and full of wrinkles came over.
Su Fan rubbed his painful neck and looked up at the old man in blood robe.
Is he Xu Sanyin?
It smells so evil, it looks even less like a good thing than a big dog.
The old man in blood robe came to the body, picked up the black bag on the ground, and checked it carefully.
"Shangxian, I have finally waited for you."
Su Fan hugged Xu Sanyin's thigh, crying and shouting.
"Fool?"
Xu Sanyin was stunned, kicked Su Fan away, and asked, "Where is the person who gave you the storage bag?"
Is this a storage bag?
I've heard my grandfather talk about it before, but I've never seen it.
"He's dead."
"Before he died, he asked me to hand over the storage bag to you."
Su Fan said quickly.
"Dead..."
Xu Sanyin's eyes trembled and asked: "Where is his body?"
"I'll take you there."
The two came to the back mountain.
Xu Sanyin dug up the soil and looked at the black-robed Taoist inside, his eyes filled with endless anger.
